data.home_page_content:
ReinventED:Your Education, Your Voice aims to amplify the voices and views of students, families and educators to inform policy in ways that are equitable, effective and efficient with a particular focus on Black, Latino, and other non-dominant communities.

To date, education policymaking has largely excluded students and families' needs and ignored systemic inequalities. 

That is why we want to hear your experiences with your education and to learn more about how you want to learn in ways that take account of differences in communities, student experiences, and aspirations.

Organized by the Governance Lab and supported by a grant from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, our goal is to enable diverse participation that will tap the know-how, experience and expertise of those most affected by education, namely students, their families and educators.
data.privacy_policy:
Overview

Your Education, Your Voice (This Website) is brought to you by The Governance Lab (The GovLab) at NYU Tandon School of Engineering. 

The GovLab respects your personal privacy. The GovLab is committed to respecting your privacy and abides by all the practices and principles outlined by New York University in its Digital Privacy Statement. For more information, please review the full statement here. If a conflict arises between the NYU Digital Privacy Statement and this document,. this Information Collection Statement controls.

What is All Our Ideas

This Website also uses third-party software, including  All Our Ideas. All Our Ideas is a wiki survey tool designed by Professor Matthew Salganik of Princeton University. All Our Ideas is powered by open source software and free to use and re-use.

 What information does All Our Ideas Collect?

You do not need to register to respond to the All Our Ideas wiki survey on this Website. You may respond to questions anonymously. We have no way to link the identity of an individual to his or her responses on All Our Ideas.

All visitors to the site will have their IP address geo-located using a publicly available database for purposes of showing you the location of participants. We do not store IP addresses in our database. Instead, we store your approximate location, as inferred from your IP address, and a cryptographic hash of your IP address in our database. We may also use third-party analytics services, such as Google Analytics, to track traffic on the website.  Please refer to the "do we use cookies?" section below for information about cookies and how we use them.*

How do we use your responses on All Our Ideas ?

We do not collect or use information about how an individual voted. Rather, we collect and use aggregate and anonymous data for research purposes. We are interested in broad patterns not in how any one particular person voted. So, for example, we are interested in the average number of votes cast in each session, but we are not interested in identifying who picked which response.

Do we use cookies?

Yes. Cookies are small files that a site or its service provider transfers to your computer's hard drive through your web browser (if you allow) that enables the sites or service providers systems to recognize your browser and capture and remember certain information. By using this Website, you acknowledge that a Google Analytics, a third-party analytics provider, will report anonymized information about the approximate locations of Website users, how long they spend on the Website, and which pages they visit in order to enable us improve this Website.

Do we disclose any information to outside parties?

Aggregated results (e.g. results of a given survey) are publicly visible to you and the world. Click on the "View Results" tab in the tool to see those results. We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer to outside parties your personally identifiable information.

What is the “Tell Us About You” Survey

The “Tell Us About You” survey is an optional survey that you can take to help us get a better sense of the demographic spread of visitors to this Website and respondents to the All Our Ideas engagement. The survey is anonymous. We do not ask for your name or any personally identifiable information. We ask you only for your: 1) city and state, 2) gender identity, 3) race and/or ethnicity, 4) education level, and 5) school type. All questions are optional. Results from this anonymous demographic survey cannot be and will not be linked to responses on the All Our Ideas software. We will share the aggregated results of the survey in the findings at the end of the project. These results will contain high-level takeaways about the survey respondents but will not contain any individual-level findings. This survey form uses Google Forms and information collected by Google is subject to their Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

Third party links

Occasionally, at our discretion, we may include links to third party websites. These third party sites have separate and independent privacy policies. We, therefore, have no responsibility or liability for the content and activities of these linked sites. Nonetheless, we seek to protect the integrity of our site and welcome any feedback about these sites.

Changes to our Information Collection Statement

We reserve the right to change our Information Collection Statement from time to time at our sole discretion. Please periodically check this section to review the current version.
